STATUS: pass

SUMMARY: The diff meets every acceptance criterion I could reach. `now=0` is honored, the 1800/1801 boundary is correct, used takes precedence over expiry, expired attempts don't consume, and the concurrency check held across 20 trials of 50 threads with exactly one success each. The only reproduced deviation is a `TypeError` on unhashable tokens. That behavior predates the diff, so I'm tagging it minor.

FILES TOUCHED: none (scratch probes ran from a `mktemp -d` directory, which I removed; `git status` is unchanged: README.md, shop/auth.py, tests/test_auth.py modified)

FINDINGS:
- [minor] Unhashable token input (`redeem_reset_token(["x"])` or `({})`) raises `TypeError: unhashable type: 'list'` instead of `InvalidToken`. Reproduced. The original code had the same behavior, and the criteria only name "" and None, so this is not a regression.
- [minor] `_TOKENS` is never pruned; the store grows with every issued token. Not in the criteria. Not reproduced as a failure, only observed (34 entries after the probe run).
- [minor] The NaN handling and its test (`test_nan_timestamp_counts_as_expired`) go beyond the criteria. The comment is accurate, so this is scope creep, not a bug.
- [minor] Float timestamps near the boundary: `now - issued_at > 1800` is evaluated literally as the spec states. I tried four large-epoch bases (for example 1e9+0.3 and 1.9e9+0.123) at exactly issued+1800 and none expired. Not reproduced as a failure.
- No blocking findings.

CHECKS:
- `./check.sh` -> pass (21 tests OK, lint clean)
- `issue(now=0)` then `redeem(now=1801)` -> TokenExpired (pass); `redeem(now=1800)` -> returns username (pass)
- issue 1000.1 / redeem 2800.1 -> accepted (pass); issue 1000 / redeem 2800.5 -> TokenExpired (pass)
- redeem earlier than issue (now=-5), and now=-inf -> accepted, no crash (pass); now=+inf -> TokenExpired (pass)
- NaN on issue or on redeem -> TokenExpired (pass)
- default `now=None` path: real-time round trip (pass); issued at time-1801 -> TokenExpired (pass); issued at time-1799 -> accepted (pass)
- 20 trials × 50 threads on one token via barrier -> exactly one success each (pass)
- expired attempt then fresh attempt at valid time -> succeeds, so the expired attempt did not consume (pass)
- used-then-expired -> TokenUsed (pass, per test suite)
- unknown "" and None -> plain InvalidToken with "unknown token" (pass, per test suite)
- str timestamp `now="1000"` -> TypeError (not in criteria; the same kind of input error existed before the diff) (minor, not reproduced as a criteria failure)
- README line placement: it sits in the rules paragraph, and the sentence matches the code (pass)
- Callers: `grep` found no other callers of `issue_reset_token`, `redeem_reset_token`, or `InvalidToken` outside shop/auth.py and the tests, so no caller was left un-updated.

OPEN QUESTIONS: Should unhashable/non-string tokens be normalized to `InvalidToken`? The criteria don't require it, so I left it as minor.
